scope: Exact remaining characteristic-two statement and source-bound elementary search corollaries
full_gate: For every m>=1, (Q_m,Q_m*)=(1) in F2[q,1/L_(2m+1)], Q_m=E_m R_m, reversal at actual degree N_m.
endpoint_gate: For every m>=1, (E_m,E_m*)=(1) in the same localized ring.

analytical_corollaries.claim: For any high-order paired support trace factor of degree r, its complete degree-2r reciprocal lift divides the accepted deflated polynomial. Therefore r<=floor(Cfull_m/2); endpoint-only r<=floor(Bend_m/2).
The exact order divides 2^r-1 for a split inverse pair or 2^r+1 for a self-reciprocal component, with exact Frobenius-degree conditions.
For the accepted affine endpoint pair, F_n prime=C_n^8 and G_n prime=(E_n*)^8; every high-order common factor is simple.

counterexample_search_boundary: The whole-cyclotomic d<=Cfull_m^2 result does not provide a justified paired-support cutoff. A synthetic degree-18 inverse pair of exact order 511>18^2 disproves the inference from residual degree alone; it is not an actual Cfull_m instance or RS counterexample.
next_decisive_lemma: A genuinely uniform actual-family endpoint support/Bezout argument; a full-gate proof additionally needs all inverse collision channels.
next_decisive_witness: One actual-family reciprocal common factor at certified exact odd order>2m+1, with both orientations independently verified.
